verdict.rationale: The IRS publishes an exact paper/fax fallback for the EIN flow, which matters because the online assistant keeps limited hours: mail or fax Form SS-4 to 'Internal Revenue Service, Attn: EIN Operation, Cincinnati, OH 45999, Fax: 855-641-6935'. It also documents a paper rail for the 83(b) election (a written statement or Form 15620 filed with the Service Center). Missing for 10: an exact address for the 83(b) paper filing (evidence only says 'the Service Center where you file your return'), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the mail/fax rails complete the task.
